sentence_pairs.en: On a podcast , I briefly mentioned that I’m building my dream house without predicting - by living in a bare cabin in the woods, then adding only what I find I actually need .
sentence_pairs.cn: 在一个播客里，我顺口提到自己正在不靠预测地建造梦想中的房子——先住进林间一间空荡荡的小木屋，然后只添置我发现自己真正需要的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: Apparently it was intriguing, because since then, it’s been my most frequently asked question: “How’s your house going?” I didn’t think this would interest total strangers, but enough people have asked, so here’s the story.
sentence_pairs.cn: 看来这话引起了大家的兴趣，因为从那以后，被问得最多的就是它："你的房子建得怎么样了？"我原以为陌生人不会对此感兴趣，但问的人实在不少，于是就有了这篇文章。

sentence_pairs.en: I hope you can apply it metaphorically to your own projects or life choices.
sentence_pairs.cn: 希望你能把它当作一个隐喻，用在自己的项目或人生选择上。

sentence_pairs.en: It starts with a maxim:
sentence_pairs.cn: 一切始于一句格言：

sentence_pairs.en: All buildings are predictions.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所有的建筑都是预测。

sentence_pairs.en: All predictions are wrong.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所有的预测都是错的。

sentence_pairs.en: How do you build without predicting?
sentence_pairs.cn: 不做预测，怎么建造？

sentence_pairs.en: Defer decisions.
sentence_pairs.cn: 推迟决定。

sentence_pairs.en: Start using what’s there.
sentence_pairs.cn: 先用起现成的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: Discover actual needs.
sentence_pairs.cn: 发现真实的需求。

sentence_pairs.en: When you catch yourself thinking “We’ll need this,” stop and say, “Let’s find out what we really need.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 当你发现自己冒出"我们会需要这个"的念头时，停下来，改口说："先弄清楚我们到底需要什么。"

sentence_pairs.en: A fabled example: They built a new park and argued about where to put the walkways.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一个经典案例：人们新建了一座公园，为步道修在哪里争论不休。

sentence_pairs.en: Around the edges?
sentence_pairs.cn: 沿着边缘？

sentence_pairs.en: Through the middle?
sentence_pairs.cn: 穿过中央？

sentence_pairs.en: The winning answer: Open the park with no walkways .
sentence_pairs.cn: 最优答案是：公园开放时一条步道都不修。

sentence_pairs.en: After a year, look where people have been walking.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一年之后，去看看人们都从哪里走。

sentence_pairs.en: Find paths where the grass is worn away.
sentence_pairs.cn: 找到那些草被踩秃的地方。

sentence_pairs.en: Pave there.
sentence_pairs.cn: 就在那里铺路。

sentence_pairs.en: Don’t predict.
sentence_pairs.cn: 不要预测。

sentence_pairs.en: I’ve preached that idea for decades.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这个理念我已经讲了十几年。

sentence_pairs.en: Then a few years ago, I bought a piece of land for dirt cheap here in New Zealand - just 30 minutes away - and applied that idea to building a home for me and my son.
sentence_pairs.cn: 几年前，我在新西兰以极便宜的价钱买下一块地——离这里只有30分钟路程——并把那个理念用在了为我和儿子建房子这件事上。

sentence_pairs.en: How do you build a home without predicting?
sentence_pairs.cn: 不靠预测，怎么建一个家？

sentence_pairs.en: By living in an unfurnished, unfinished place, adding only what you’ve proven you need or want.
sentence_pairs.cn: 住进一个没有家具、尚未完工的地方，只添置那些你已证明自己需要或想要的东西。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s a fun philosophical experiment, testing what you really need.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是一场有趣的哲学实验：检验你到底需要什么。

sentence_pairs.en: Especially when costs are high, it raises the bar on that word: “need”.
sentence_pairs.cn: 尤其当代价高昂时，它会抬高"需要"这个词的门槛。

sentence_pairs.en: (Note: I will say “I” and “my”, but my teenage son was very involved in most of these decisions, and loves this place even more than I do.)
sentence_pairs.cn: （说明：下文我会说"我"和"我的"，但其实大多数决定都有我十几岁儿子的深度参与，他比我更喜欢这个地方。）

sentence_pairs.en: My land is an off-grid forest valley with a creek running through the middle.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我的地是一处离网的森林山谷，一条小溪从中间流过。

sentence_pairs.en: No buildings, no electricity or services.
sentence_pairs.cn: 没有建筑，没有电，也没有任何市政管线。

sentence_pairs.en: Just land.
sentence_pairs.cn: 只有土地。

sentence_pairs.en: So I really started from scratch.
sentence_pairs.cn: 所以我是真正从零开始的。

sentence_pairs.en: For two years, before building anything, we spent time there in all seasons, finding our favorite spots.
sentence_pairs.cn: 动工之前的两年里，我们四季都去那里待，寻找自己最喜欢的角落。

sentence_pairs.en: We built a path through our forest.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们在林子里修了一条小径。

sentence_pairs.en: Twice, we came face-to-face with a wild boar .
sentence_pairs.cn: 有两次，我们和一头野猪打了照面。

sentence_pairs.en: I slept outside, so I know I need a roof, walls, and great insulation - about 4 by 8 meters.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我睡过露天，所以我知道自己需要屋顶、墙和很好的保温——大约4米乘8米。

sentence_pairs.en: I bought a used, pre-made, well-insulated 4 by 8 cabin .
sentence_pairs.cn: 我买了一间二手的预制小木屋，4米乘8米，保温很好。

sentence_pairs.en: Because they were on a clearance sale, I bought three more, so now we have four adjacent cabins for four purposes:
sentence_pairs.cn: 因为赶上清仓甩卖，我又买了三间——现在我们有四间相邻的小木屋，派四种用场：

sentence_pairs.en: for sleeping
sentence_pairs.cn: 一间用来睡觉

sentence_pairs.en: for me (where I spend most waking hours)
sentence_pairs.cn: 一间给我（我大部分清醒的时间都在这里度过）

sentence_pairs.en: for him (where my son does whatever he wants)
sentence_pairs.cn: 一间给他（我儿子想干什么就干什么的地方）

sentence_pairs.en: for storage or future living.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一间储物，或留作日后的住处。

sentence_pairs.en: I love the isolation of purposes.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我喜欢这种用途分离。

sentence_pairs.en: When I go into my cabin, it’s time to work.
sentence_pairs.cn: 走进我的小屋，就是工作时间。

sentence_pairs.en: When we go into the sleeping cabin, it’s time for bed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 走进睡觉的小屋，就该上床了。

sentence_pairs.en: I slept on the floor, so I know I need a mattress and blankets.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我睡过地板，所以我知道自己需要床垫和毯子。

sentence_pairs.en: I bought a mattress and blankets and started living there .
sentence_pairs.cn: 我买了床垫和毯子，开始住在那里。

sentence_pairs.en: I tried living without electricity, then planned on going solar-only, but I decided to get fast fiber internet.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我试过不用电生活，后来计划只用太阳能，但最终还是决定接入高速光纤网络。

sentence_pairs.en: Since I was digging a trench for the fiber optic cables to run from the road to my house, it made sense to get electric service.
sentence_pairs.cn: 反正要为光纤挖一条从公路通到房子的沟渠，顺便接通电也很合理。

sentence_pairs.en: These ideas are from the book “How Buildings Learn” by Stewart Brand .
sentence_pairs.cn: 这些想法来自斯图尔特·布兰德（Stewart Brand）的《建筑如何学习》（How Buildings Learn）一书。

sentence_pairs.en: For 20 years, it’s been a huge influence on my code, my life choices, and now on building my home.
sentence_pairs.cn: 二十年来，它深刻影响了我的代码、我的人生选择，如今又影响着我如何建造自己的家。

sentence_pairs.en: If you find this fascinating or crazy, go read that book .
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果你觉得这一切迷人也够疯狂，去读读那本书吧。

sentence_pairs.en: It makes a powerful point about water:
sentence_pairs.cn: 书里关于水有一个非常有力的论点：

sentence_pairs.en: “Water consumes wood, erodes masonry, corrodes metals, peels paint, and expands when it freezes.
sentence_pairs.cn: "水吞噬木头，侵蚀砖石，锈蚀金属，剥落油漆，冻结时还会膨胀。

sentence_pairs.en: It warps, swells, discolors, rusts, loosens, mildews, and stinks.
sentence_pairs.cn: 它让房屋扭曲、鼓胀、变色、生锈、松动、发霉、发臭。

sentence_pairs.en: Houses deteriorate from the bathroom out.”
sentence_pairs.cn: 房子是从浴室开始烂掉的。"

sentence_pairs.en: Heeding his warning, I made a rule of no water inside .
sentence_pairs.cn: 我听从了他的警告，定下一条规矩：屋里不放水。

sentence_pairs.en: Anything with water stays outside the cabins.
sentence_pairs.cn: 凡是带水的东西，都留在小屋之外。

sentence_pairs.en: Outdoor showers, I’ve always loved, so now it’s all I’ve got.
sentence_pairs.cn: 户外淋浴我一直很喜欢，所以现在我就只有它了。

sentence_pairs.en: A simple hose shower that runs the water through a heater.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一根简单的软管淋浴，让水流经加热器。

sentence_pairs.en: Uncovered, so at night I shower while looking at the stars.
sentence_pairs.cn: 没有顶棚，所以夜里我可以边淋浴边看星星。

sentence_pairs.en: Outdoor kitchen, holding an umbrella while cooking in the rain, proved I needed a roof.
sentence_pairs.cn: 户外厨房——在雨里打着伞做饭——证明了我需要一个屋顶。

sentence_pairs.en: Thin walls and a floating roof so the wind can circulate but keeps away the rain.
sentence_pairs.cn: 薄墙加悬浮式屋顶，风可以流通，雨却进不来。

sentence_pairs.en: Wonderful except in winter, but a few minutes of cold hands are worth it for no fumes or smoke in the home.
sentence_pairs.cn: 除了冬天都很好受；手上冷几分钟，换来家里没有油烟和烟气，值了。

sentence_pairs.en: Outdoor bathroom, can I handle that?
sentence_pairs.cn: 户外厕所，我能受得了吗？

sentence_pairs.en: I tried peeing outside for a month and it was fine.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我试着在户外小便了一个月，完全没问题。

sentence_pairs.en: I built the same structure as the kitchen.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我建了和厨房一样的结构。

sentence_pairs.en: It’s actually really nice in there in a rainstorm.
sentence_pairs.cn: 暴雨天人待在里面其实特别舒服。

sentence_pairs.en: Got a composting toilet instead of flushing, which saves a lot of water.
sentence_pairs.cn: 用堆肥马桶代替冲水马桶，省下大量的水。

sentence_pairs.en: Remember, my land is “off-grid” so I have no water supply, and no wastewater service.
sentence_pairs.cn: 别忘了，我的地是"离网"的，所以没有供水，也没有污水处理服务。

sentence_pairs.en: My only water source is collecting the rain from my roof.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我唯一的水源是收集屋顶上的雨水。

sentence_pairs.en: Gutters and tanks, and good water filtration.
sentence_pairs.cn: 排水槽、储水罐，再加上良好的过滤。

sentence_pairs.en: Later I added a reverse osmosis water filter for drinking.
sentence_pairs.cn: 后来又添了一台反渗透净水器，专门管饮用水。

sentence_pairs.en: Another nice thing about having the cabins, kitchen, and bathroom all separated, is that it keeps you going outside almost every hour .
sentence_pairs.cn: 小屋、厨房、厕所彼此分开还有个好处：几乎每个钟头你都得出门走一趟。

sentence_pairs.en: It snaps you out of your thoughts and into the real physical world of trees, birds, wind and weather.
sentence_pairs.cn: 它把你从思绪里拽出来，拉进树木、飞鸟、风与天气这个真实的物理世界。

sentence_pairs.en: Every night at dusk, the owls start their beautiful “hoo-hoo ...
sentence_pairs.cn: 每天黄昏，猫头鹰就开始了它们那动听的"呜呼、呜呼……

sentence_pairs.en: hoo-hoo”.
sentence_pairs.cn: 呜呼"。

sentence_pairs.en: This is a cold dark valley so I wanted a sauna for sanity, pleasure, and health.
sentence_pairs.cn: 这是一个又冷又暗的山谷，所以我想要一间桑拿房——为了清醒、愉悦和健康。

sentence_pairs.en: Glenn Auerbach from Sauna Times designed a great little two-person sauna for us.
sentence_pairs.cn: Sauna Times 的格伦·奥尔巴赫（Glenn Auerbach）为我们设计了一间很棒的小型双人桑拿房。

sentence_pairs.en: Now it’s my nightly ritual : Hot sauna, 82°C for 21 minutes , then shower, then bed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 现在这是我每晚的仪式：82摄氏度的热桑拿蒸21分钟，然后冲澡，然后睡觉。

sentence_pairs.en: Coming straight from the sauna makes the outdoor shower more appealing on cold nights.
sentence_pairs.cn: 冷夜里从桑拿房出来直接去冲户外淋浴，反而更叫人期待。

sentence_pairs.en: I hate hanging laundry, so I got a washer and dryer.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我讨厌晾衣服，所以买了洗衣机和烘干机。

sentence_pairs.en: But I’m happy to do dishes, so no dishwasher.
sentence_pairs.cn: 但我很乐意洗碗，所以没买洗碗机。

sentence_pairs.en: Do I need hot water in the sink?
sentence_pairs.cn: 水槽需要热水吗？

sentence_pairs.en: I went without it for a year, and found I never needed hot water - only cold or boiling.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我一年没用热水，结果发现自己从来不需要温水——要么冷水，要么滚水。

sentence_pairs.en: So instead of an expensive water heater, I keep a kettle by the sink for dishes and tea.
sentence_pairs.cn: 于是我没有买昂贵的热水器，而是在水槽边放一把水壶，洗碗泡茶都用它。

sentence_pairs.en: And no built-in appliances - only portable, for easy changes.
sentence_pairs.cn: 也不用任何嵌入式电器——只买可移动的，方便日后调整。

sentence_pairs.en: I design for maintenance, not appearances, so all conduit and pipes are exposed.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我按"易于维护"而不是"好看"来设计，所以所有线管和管道都是明装的。

sentence_pairs.en: Nothing hidden.
sentence_pairs.cn: 什么都不藏。

sentence_pairs.en: That said, I planted privacy bushes around the perimeter, since, y’know, I like to shower naked.
sentence_pairs.cn: 话虽如此，我在四周种了一圈绿篱——毕竟，你懂的，我喜欢光着身子洗澡。

sentence_pairs.en: The story continues, but that’s enough.
sentence_pairs.cn: 故事还在继续，但写到这里就够了。

sentence_pairs.en: For each choice , like where to put lights, the process is:
sentence_pairs.cn: 每一个选择——比如灯装在哪里——流程都是这样：

sentence_pairs.en: Try to do without it.
sentence_pairs.cn: 先试试没有它行不行。

sentence_pairs.en: Stop here if possible.
sentence_pairs.cn: 如果可以，就到此为止。

sentence_pairs.en: Try a cheap portable fix , like a flashlight or lantern.
sentence_pairs.cn: 再试一个便宜的、可移动的替代方案，比如手电筒或提灯。

sentence_pairs.en: Stop here if possible.
sentence_pairs.cn: 能到此为止，就到此为止。

sentence_pairs.en: Test a simple flexible solution, easy to maintain and change.
sentence_pairs.cn: 然后试一种简单灵活、易于维护和更换的方案。

sentence_pairs.en: We’ve been living here full-time for a year and it’s really ideal.
sentence_pairs.cn: 我们已经在这里全职住了一年，真的非常理想。

sentence_pairs.en: It feels like custom tailored clothing .
sentence_pairs.cn: 感觉就像量身定制的衣服。

sentence_pairs.en: Instead of generic “one size fits all”, it’s a house that perfectly fits our unique preferences and values.
sentence_pairs.cn: 不是通用的"均码"，而是一栋完全贴合我们独特偏好与价值观的房子。

sentence_pairs.en: A neighbor came by for the first time and really hated it , getting all upset and yelling, saying I was crazy for not having his preferred comforts.
sentence_pairs.cn: 一位邻居第一次来做客，非常看不惯，气得大喊大叫，说我没有他喜欢的那些舒适设施，简直是疯了。

sentence_pairs.en: I love that this home feels wrong for others, and just right for us .
sentence_pairs.cn: 我喜欢这栋房子在别人眼里的"不对劲"，和在我们眼里的"刚刚好"。

sentence_pairs.en: (Kind of like my software and other life choices .) It’s a fun ongoing experiment and reminder to challenge all predictions .
sentence_pairs.cn: （有点像我的软件和其他人生选择。）这是一场持续进行的有趣实验，也提醒我去挑战一切预测。

sentence_pairs.en: (I have not taken any photos of the house, because I don’t care how it looks, and I almost never take photos of anything.)
sentence_pairs.cn: （我没有拍过房子的照片，因为我不在乎它长什么样，而且我几乎从不给任何东西拍照。）

sentences.en: So I really started from scratch.
sentences.cn: 所以我是真正从零开始的。

sentences.en: For two years, before building anything, we spent time there in all seasons, finding our favorite spots.
sentences.cn: 动工之前的两年里，我们四季都去那里待，寻找自己最喜欢的角落。

sentences.en: We built a path through our forest.
sentences.cn: 我们在林子里修了一条小径。

sentences.en: Twice, we came face-to-face with a wild boar .
sentences.cn: 有两次，我们和一头野猪打了照面。

sentences.en: I slept outside, so I know I need a roof, walls, and great insulation - about 4 by 8 meters.
sentences.cn: 我睡过露天，所以我知道自己需要屋顶、墙和很好的保温——大约4米乘8米。

sentences.en: I bought a used, pre-made, well-insulated 4 by 8 cabin .
sentences.cn: 我买了一间二手的预制小木屋，4米乘8米，保温很好。

sentences.en: Because they were on a clearance sale, I bought three more, so now we have four adjacent cabins for four purposes:
sentences.cn: 因为赶上清仓甩卖，我又买了三间——现在我们有四间相邻的小木屋，派四种用场：

sentences.en: for sleeping
sentences.cn: 一间用来睡觉

sentences.en: for me (where I spend most waking hours)
sentences.cn: 一间给我（我大部分清醒的时间都在这里度过）

sentences.en: for him (where my son does whatever he wants)
sentences.cn: 一间给他（我儿子想干什么就干什么的地方）

sentences.en: for storage or future living.
sentences.cn: 一间储物，或留作日后的住处。

sentences.en: I love the isolation of purposes.
sentences.cn: 我喜欢这种用途分离。

sentences.en: When I go into my cabin, it’s time to work.
sentences.cn: 走进我的小屋，就是工作时间。

sentences.en: When we go into the sleeping cabin, it’s time for bed.
sentences.cn: 走进睡觉的小屋，就该上床了。

sentences.en: I slept on the floor, so I know I need a mattress and blankets.
sentences.cn: 我睡过地板，所以我知道自己需要床垫和毯子。

sentences.en: I bought a mattress and blankets and started living there .
sentences.cn: 我买了床垫和毯子，开始住在那里。

sentences.en: I tried living without electricity, then planned on going solar-only, but I decided to get fast fiber internet.
sentences.cn: 我试过不用电生活，后来计划只用太阳能，但最终还是决定接入高速光纤网络。

sentences.en: Since I was digging a trench for the fiber optic cables to run from the road to my house, it made sense to get electric service.
sentences.cn: 反正要为光纤挖一条从公路通到房子的沟渠，顺便接通电也很合理。

sentences.en: These ideas are from the book “How Buildings Learn” by Stewart Brand .
sentences.cn: 这些想法来自斯图尔特·布兰德（Stewart Brand）的《建筑如何学习》（How Buildings Learn）一书。

sentences.en: For 20 years, it’s been a huge influence on my code, my life choices, and now on building my home.
sentences.cn: 二十年来，它深刻影响了我的代码、我的人生选择，如今又影响着我如何建造自己的家。

sentences.en: If you find this fascinating or crazy, go read that book .
sentences.cn: 如果你觉得这一切迷人也够疯狂，去读读那本书吧。

sentences.en: It makes a powerful point about water:
sentences.cn: 书里关于水有一个非常有力的论点：

sentences.en: “Water consumes wood, erodes masonry, corrodes metals, peels paint, and expands when it freezes.
sentences.cn: "水吞噬木头，侵蚀砖石，锈蚀金属，剥落油漆，冻结时还会膨胀。

sentences.en: It warps, swells, discolors, rusts, loosens, mildews, and stinks.
sentences.cn: 它让房屋扭曲、鼓胀、变色、生锈、松动、发霉、发臭。

sentences.en: Houses deteriorate from the bathroom out.”
sentences.cn: 房子是从浴室开始烂掉的。"

sentences.en: Heeding his warning, I made a rule of no water inside .
sentences.cn: 我听从了他的警告，定下一条规矩：屋里不放水。

sentences.en: Anything with water stays outside the cabins.
sentences.cn: 凡是带水的东西，都留在小屋之外。

sentences.en: Outdoor showers, I’ve always loved, so now it’s all I’ve got.
sentences.cn: 户外淋浴我一直很喜欢，所以现在我就只有它了。

sentences.en: A simple hose shower that runs the water through a heater.
sentences.cn: 一根简单的软管淋浴，让水流经加热器。

sentences.en: Uncovered, so at night I shower while looking at the stars.
sentences.cn: 没有顶棚，所以夜里我可以边淋浴边看星星。

sentences.en: Outdoor kitchen, holding an umbrella while cooking in the rain, proved I needed a roof.
sentences.cn: 户外厨房——在雨里打着伞做饭——证明了我需要一个屋顶。

sentences.en: Thin walls and a floating roof so the wind can circulate but keeps away the rain.
sentences.cn: 薄墙加悬浮式屋顶，风可以流通，雨却进不来。

sentences.en: Wonderful except in winter, but a few minutes of cold hands are worth it for no fumes or smoke in the home.
sentences.cn: 除了冬天都很好受；手上冷几分钟，换来家里没有油烟和烟气，值了。

sentences.en: Outdoor bathroom, can I handle that?
sentences.cn: 户外厕所，我能受得了吗？

sentences.en: I tried peeing outside for a month and it was fine.
sentences.cn: 我试着在户外小便了一个月，完全没问题。

sentences.en: I built the same structure as the kitchen.
sentences.cn: 我建了和厨房一样的结构。

sentences.en: It’s actually really nice in there in a rainstorm.
sentences.cn: 暴雨天人待在里面其实特别舒服。

sentences.en: Got a composting toilet instead of flushing, which saves a lot of water.
sentences.cn: 用堆肥马桶代替冲水马桶，省下大量的水。

sentences.en: Remember, my land is “off-grid” so I have no water supply, and no wastewater service.
sentences.cn: 别忘了，我的地是"离网"的，所以没有供水，也没有污水处理服务。

sentences.en: My only water source is collecting the rain from my roof.
sentences.cn: 我唯一的水源是收集屋顶上的雨水。

sentences.en: Gutters and tanks, and good water filtration.
sentences.cn: 排水槽、储水罐，再加上良好的过滤。

sentences.en: Later I added a reverse osmosis water filter for drinking.
sentences.cn: 后来又添了一台反渗透净水器，专门管饮用水。

sentences.en: Another nice thing about having the cabins, kitchen, and bathroom all separated, is that it keeps you going outside almost every hour .
sentences.cn: 小屋、厨房、厕所彼此分开还有个好处：几乎每个钟头你都得出门走一趟。

sentences.en: It snaps you out of your thoughts and into the real physical world of trees, birds, wind and weather.
sentences.cn: 它把你从思绪里拽出来，拉进树木、飞鸟、风与天气这个真实的物理世界。

sentences.en: Every night at dusk, the owls start their beautiful “hoo-hoo ...
sentences.cn: 每天黄昏，猫头鹰就开始了它们那动听的"呜呼、呜呼……

sentences.en: hoo-hoo”.
sentences.cn: 呜呼"。

sentences.en: This is a cold dark valley so I wanted a sauna for sanity, pleasure, and health.
sentences.cn: 这是一个又冷又暗的山谷，所以我想要一间桑拿房——为了清醒、愉悦和健康。

sentences.en: Glenn Auerbach from Sauna Times designed a great little two-person sauna for us.
sentences.cn: Sauna Times 的格伦·奥尔巴赫（Glenn Auerbach）为我们设计了一间很棒的小型双人桑拿房。

sentences.en: Now it’s my nightly ritual : Hot sauna, 82°C for 21 minutes , then shower, then bed.
sentences.cn: 现在这是我每晚的仪式：82摄氏度的热桑拿蒸21分钟，然后冲澡，然后睡觉。

sentences.en: Coming straight from the sauna makes the outdoor shower more appealing on cold nights.
sentences.cn: 冷夜里从桑拿房出来直接去冲户外淋浴，反而更叫人期待。

sentences.en: I hate hanging laundry, so I got a washer and dryer.
sentences.cn: 我讨厌晾衣服，所以买了洗衣机和烘干机。

sentences.en: But I’m happy to do dishes, so no dishwasher.
sentences.cn: 但我很乐意洗碗，所以没买洗碗机。

sentences.en: Do I need hot water in the sink?
sentences.cn: 水槽需要热水吗？

sentences.en: I went without it for a year, and found I never needed hot water - only cold or boiling.
sentences.cn: 我一年没用热水，结果发现自己从来不需要温水——要么冷水，要么滚水。

sentences.en: So instead of an expensive water heater, I keep a kettle by the sink for dishes and tea.
sentences.cn: 于是我没有买昂贵的热水器，而是在水槽边放一把水壶，洗碗泡茶都用它。

sentences.en: And no built-in appliances - only portable, for easy changes.
sentences.cn: 也不用任何嵌入式电器——只买可移动的，方便日后调整。

sentences.en: I design for maintenance, not appearances, so all conduit and pipes are exposed.
sentences.cn: 我按"易于维护"而不是"好看"来设计，所以所有线管和管道都是明装的。

sentences.en: Nothing hidden.
sentences.cn: 什么都不藏。

sentences.en: That said, I planted privacy bushes around the perimeter, since, y’know, I like to shower naked.
sentences.cn: 话虽如此，我在四周种了一圈绿篱——毕竟，你懂的，我喜欢光着身子洗澡。

sentences.en: The story continues, but that’s enough.
sentences.cn: 故事还在继续，但写到这里就够了。

sentences.en: For each choice , like where to put lights, the process is:
sentences.cn: 每一个选择——比如灯装在哪里——流程都是这样：

sentences.en: Try to do without it.
sentences.cn: 先试试没有它行不行。

sentences.en: Stop here if possible.
sentences.cn: 如果可以，就到此为止。

sentences.en: Try a cheap portable fix , like a flashlight or lantern.
sentences.cn: 再试一个便宜的、可移动的替代方案，比如手电筒或提灯。

sentences.en: Stop here if possible.
sentences.cn: 能到此为止，就到此为止。

sentences.en: Test a simple flexible solution, easy to maintain and change.
sentences.cn: 然后试一种简单灵活、易于维护和更换的方案。

sentences.en: We’ve been living here full-time for a year and it’s really ideal.
sentences.cn: 我们已经在这里全职住了一年，真的非常理想。

sentences.en: It feels like custom tailored clothing .
sentences.cn: 感觉就像量身定制的衣服。

sentences.en: Instead of generic “one size fits all”, it’s a house that perfectly fits our unique preferences and values.
sentences.cn: 不是通用的"均码"，而是一栋完全贴合我们独特偏好与价值观的房子。

sentences.en: A neighbor came by for the first time and really hated it , getting all upset and yelling, saying I was crazy for not having his preferred comforts.
sentences.cn: 一位邻居第一次来做客，非常看不惯，气得大喊大叫，说我没有他喜欢的那些舒适设施，简直是疯了。

sentences.en: I love that this home feels wrong for others, and just right for us .
sentences.cn: 我喜欢这栋房子在别人眼里的"不对劲"，和在我们眼里的"刚刚好"。

sentences.en: (Kind of like my software and other life choices .) It’s a fun ongoing experiment and reminder to challenge all predictions .
sentences.cn: （有点像我的软件和其他人生选择。）这是一场持续进行的有趣实验，也提醒我去挑战一切预测。

sentences.en: (I have not taken any photos of the house, because I don’t care how it looks, and I almost never take photos of anything.)
sentences.cn: （我没有拍过房子的照片，因为我不在乎它长什么样，而且我几乎从不给任何东西拍照。）
